title: Columns, rows, gaps
learningObjectives: Explain columns, rows, gaps and build a responsive layout with it.

understand.concept: grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows define explicit grid tracks. gap, row-gap, and column-gap create spacing between tracks. Track sizes can use fixed, flexible, percentage, and intrinsic sizing values.
understand.whyItMatters: Track definitions should account for available space and content minimums. A fixed track can overflow on a narrow screen; fr and minmax() can create more flexible layouts.
understand.analogy: Rows and columns are the lanes of a grid; gap is the space between those lanes.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; actual layout follows the flex or grid formatting algorithm.

explain.narrative: The grid creates two equal flexible columns and a one-rem gap between rows and columns.

examples.explanation: The grid creates two equal flexible columns and a one-rem gap between rows and columns.
examples.expectedOutput: A browser-rendered layout demonstrating the lesson concept.

practise.guidedTask: Change the grid to three columns, then use a media query to return to one column on a narrow screen.
practise.independentTask: Build a small responsive interface using the concept. Test long labels and more than one viewport width.
hints: Inspect the layout overlay in developer tools.
Change one container or item property at a time.
Check for overflow and preserve reading order.
